name: TDEX
recent: TDEX 正在推进最多 10% 已发行股份的私募配售，并已获 Bursa Securities 批准将完成期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 4 月 27 日。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 10 日召开第 22 届常年股东大会，同时公告与 Gurun Power Generation 的经常性关联交易金额已超过集团净资产的 1%。
notable: Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension to 27 April 2027 for TDEX to complete its private placement of up to 10% of issued shares.。

TDEX will hold its 22nd AGM on 10 December 2026, with resolutions including directors' fees, re-election of directors, re-appointment of auditors, and a new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions.。
Recurrent related party transactions with Gurun Power Generation from 2 April 2026 to 1 September 2026 exceeded 1% of the group's audited consolidated net assets as at 30 June 2025.。
risks: The proposed private placement of up to 10% of issued shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity interest.。
The private placement's completion deadline has been extended to 27 April 2027, indicating a delay in implementation.。
